room.title: Add room
room.description: Choose the radar sensor of this room. Distance and X/Y of the first target are optional but needed for the door range and sub-areas.

area.title: Add sub-area
area.description: A rectangle in the radar coordinates of the room sensor. Disappearing here never counts as leaving the room.

data.safety_timeout: Release after no presence for (0 = never)
data.handover_anywhere: Hand over even when lost away from the door
data.takeover_min: Take over only from this distance
data.window_end: Time window to (same as start = always)

data_description.door_from: The room is left only if the target disappears in this distance range. 0 to 0 means every disappearance counts as leaving.
data_description.handover: Single-person household only: when this room lost its target and another taking part room sees someone, this room is free.
data_description.takeover_min: Ignore targets of this room's sensor that are closer, e.g. a fixed echo from a door leaf.
data_description.run_on: Delay after the room became free.

target_present.message: A target is present; only a held occupancy can be released.

leave_first.message: Walk out through the door first, then press.

no_distance.message: No distance seen yet; a distance entity is required.
